summary: Iteration 7 verifies CSV import delimiter auto-detection for POST /api/cameras/import. Added 7 new tests: semicolon (Excel Indonesian), comma (regression), tab, case-insensitive+BOM headers, missing required headers -> 400 with delimiter+columns in detail, empty file -> 400, template endpoint unchanged. Updated legacy test_import_cameras_valid_csv to assert new 'delimiter' key. Backend: 42/42 pytest cases green.
critical_code_review_comments: csv.Sniffer.sniff can misdetect delimiter if the header line contains a quoted field with commas — fine for current usage but consider passing only the first line to sniff() for speed and accuracy.

The manual fallback loop after Sniffer failure is unreachable in practice because Sniffer rarely raises on ASCII CSVs with the provided candidate list; it also iterates ';,\t,|,' in a hardcoded order which biases detection — acceptable but document intent.

The 'id' column handling uses a tricky short-circuit: `(row.get(key('id')) or '').strip() or str(uuid.uuid4()) if key('id') else str(uuid.uuid4())` — readable but operator precedence-sensitive. Consider extracting to a helper for clarity.

Error messages returned to the client mix Indonesian ('File CSV kosong', 'belum dikonfigurasi') with English elsewhere ('Header wajib ... tidak ditemukan'). Consider standardising locale via i18n instead of hardcoded strings.
server.py is now ~488 lines. Move CSV import + telegram + reports into services/*.py before growing past 600.

context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/cameras/import response schema: {inserted:int, skipped:int, delimiter:str (one of ',' ';' '\t' '|'), errors:list[str, max 15]}. Missing name/ip headers -> 400 with detail containing detected columns and delimiter. Empty body -> 400 'File CSV kosong'. Sniffer detects delimiter from first 2048 bytes. Headers are normalised: stripped, lowercased, BOM removed. Extra unknown columns are ignored.
rca of the issue: N/A - bug fix verified working. Original bug: Excel on Windows (Indonesian locale) saves CSV with ';' as list separator; backend used csv.DictReader with default ',' delimiter, so the whole header collapsed into one column named 'name;ip;nvr;location;picture_url', failing the `if 'name' not in fieldnames` check and either 400ing or silently inserting 0 rows. Fix now sniffs delimiter from ',;\t|' and returns it in response so UI can show diagnostic info.
